headline: Operating loss widens; buybacks cushion the balance sheet
summary_short: Roivant's revenue fell 33.5% y/y to $1.4 million in the quarter ended June 30, 2026 as operating loss widened to $366.0 million on higher R&D and G&A spend, while the company held $3.9 billion of consolidated cash and marketable securities and repurchased $208.7 million of shares during the quarter.
summary_long: Operating loss widened y/y to $366.0 million as R&D rose $49.1 million to $202.0 million (anti-FcRn franchise and mosliciguat program costs, plus Moderna-settlement bonuses) and G&A rose $31.5 million to $165.5 million (settlement bonuses and payroll taxes on equity awards). Net loss attributable to Roivant narrowed to $189.8 million only because noncontrolling interests absorbed a larger loss share ($100.8 million vs $50.6 million); total consolidated net loss actually widened. Cash fell sequentially to $1,248.5 million and shareholders' equity to $4,231.3 million after $208.7 million of share buybacks (7.3 million shares). Genevant/Arbutus received $950 million from Moderna in July, after quarter-end, with $1.3 billion more contingent on appeal. No quantified financial guidance was given.
